## Join the Group

The [Research Engineering Group (REG) web pages](https://bristol-reg.github.io/) contain key details about how to join and engage the community.

## Mailing list and Slack channel

For more details about joining the mailing list and accessing the #bristol-reg Slack channel please see the [Research Engineering Group contact details](https://bristol-reg.github.io/contact.html).

## REG activities

Please see the Research Engineering Group [About Our Group page](https://bristol-reg.github.io/about.html) for more details of our activities.

The regular activities we run include:

- Group meetings - every month we meet to share announcements and to allow group members to discuss and present their work and topics of interest.
- Reading group - every month we review and discuss an article voted on by the group.
